model_family: &amp;review_model_family,\n        features: &amp;review_features,\n    });\n\n    let base_instructions = REVIEW_PROMPT.to_string();\n    let review_prompt = review_request.prompt.clone();\n    let provider = parent_turn_context.client.get_provider();\n    let auth_manager = parent_turn_context.client.get_auth_manager();\n    let model_family = review_model_family.clone();\n\n    // Build per‑turn client with the requested model/family.\n    let mut per_turn_config = (*config).clone();\n    per_turn_config.model = model.clone();\n    per_turn_config.model_family = model_family.clone();\n    per_turn_config.model_reasoning_effort = Some(ReasoningEffortConfig::Low);\n    per_turn_config.model_reasoning_summary = ReasoningSummaryConfig::Detailed;\n    per_turn_config.features = review_features.clone();\n    if let Some(model_info) = get_model_info(&amp;model_family) {\n        per_turn_config.model_context_window = Some(model_info.context_window);\n    }\n\n    let otel_event_manager = parent_turn_context\n        .client\n        .get_otel_event_manager()\n        .with_model(\n            per_turn_config.model.as_str(),\n            per_turn_config.model_family.slug.as_str(),\n        );\n\n    let per_turn_config = Arc::new(per_turn_config);\n    let client = ModelClient::new(\n        per_turn_config.clone(),\n        auth_manager,\n        otel_event_manager,\n        provider,\n        per_turn_config.model_reasoning_effort,\n        per_turn_config.model_reasoning_summary,\n        sess.conversation_id,\n        parent_turn_context.client.get_session_source(),\n    );\n\n    let review_turn_context = TurnContext {\n        sub_id: sub_id.to_string(),\n        client,\n        tools_config,\n        developer_instructions: None,\n        user_instructions: None,\n        base_instructions: Some(base_instructions.clone()),\n        compact_prompt: parent_turn_context.compact_prompt.clone(),\n        approval_policy: parent_turn_context.approval_policy,\n        sandbox_policy: parent_turn_context.sandbox_policy.clone(),\n        shell_environment_policy: parent_turn_context.shell_environment_policy.clone(),\n        cwd: parent_turn_context.cwd.clone(),\n        final_output_json_schema: None,\n        codex_linux_sandbox_exe: parent_turn_context.codex_linux_sandbox_exe.clone(),\n        tool_call_gate: Arc::new(ReadinessFlag::new()),\n    };\n\n    // Seed the child task with the review prompt as the initial user message.\n    let input: Vec&lt;UserInput&gt; = vec![UserInput::Text {\n        text: review_prompt,\n    }];\n    let tc = Arc::new(review_turn_context);\n    sess.spawn_task(tc.clone(), input, ReviewTask).await;\n\n    // Announce entering review mode so UIs can switch modes.\n    sess.send_event(&amp;tc, EventMsg::EnteredReviewMode(review_request))\n        .await;\n}\n\nfn skill_load_outcome_for_client(\n    outcome: Option&lt;&amp;SkillLoadOutcome&gt;,\n) -&gt; Option&lt;SkillLoadOutcomeInfo&gt; {\n    outcome.map(|outcome| SkillLoadOutcomeInfo {\n        skills: outcome\n            .skills\n            .iter()\n            .map(|skill| SkillInfo {\n                name: skill.name.clone(),\n                description: skill.description.clone(),\n                path: skill.path.clone(),\n            })\n            .collect(),\n        errors: outcome\n            .errors\n            .iter()\n            .map(|err| SkillErrorInfo {\n                path: err.path.clone(),\n                message: err.message.clone(),\n            })\n            .collect(),\n    })\n}\n\n/// Takes a user message as input and runs a loop where, at each turn, the model\n/// replies with either:\n///\n/// - requested function calls\n/// - an assistant message\n///\n/// While it is possible for the model to return multiple of these items in a\n/// single turn, in practice, we generally one item per turn:\n///\n/// - If the model requests a function call, we execute it and send the output\n///   back to the model in the next turn.\n/// - If the model sends only an assistant message, we record it in the\n///   conversation history and consider the task complete.\n///\npub(crate) async fn run_task(\n    sess: Arc&lt;Session&gt;,\n    turn_context: Arc&lt;TurnContext&gt;,\n    input: Vec&lt;UserInput&gt;,\n    cancellation_token: CancellationToken,\n) -&gt; Option&lt;String&gt; {\n    if input.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    let event = EventMsg::TaskStarted(TaskStartedEvent {\n        model_context_window: turn_context.client.get_model_context_window(),\n    });\n    sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, event).await;\n\n    let SkillInjections {\n        items: skill_items,\n        warnings: skill_warnings,\n    } = build_skill_injections(&amp;input, sess.services.skills.as_ref()).await;\n\n    for message in skill_warnings {\n        sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, EventMsg::Warning(WarningEvent { message }))\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    let initial_input_for_turn: ResponseInputItem = ResponseInputItem::from(input);\n    sess.record_input_and_rollout_usermsg(turn_context.as_ref(), &amp;initial_input_for_turn)\n        .await;\n\n    if !skill_items.is_empty() {\n        sess.record_conversation_items(&amp;turn_context, &amp;skill_items)\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    sess.maybe_start_ghost_snapshot(Arc::clone(&amp;turn_context), cancellation_token.child_token())\n        .await;\n    let mut last_agent_message: Option&lt;String&gt; = None;\n    // Although from the perspective of codex.rs, TurnDiffTracker has the lifecycle of a Task which contains\n    // many turns, from the perspective of the user, it is a single turn.\n    let turn_diff_tracker = Arc::new(tokio::sync::Mutex::new(TurnDiffTracker::new()));\n    let mut auto_compact_recently_attempted = false;\n\n    loop {\n        // Note that pending_input would be something like a message the user\n        // submitted through the UI while the model was running. Though the UI\n        // may support this, the model might not.\n        let pending_input = sess\n            .get_pending_input()\n            .await\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(ResponseItem::from)\n            .collect::&lt;Vec&lt;ResponseItem&gt;&gt;();\n\n        // Construct the input that we will send to the model.\n        let turn_input: Vec&lt;ResponseItem&gt; = {\n            sess.record_conversation_items(&amp;turn_context, &amp;pending_input)\n                .await;\n            sess.clone_history().await.get_history_for_prompt()\n        };\n\n        let turn_input_messages = turn_input\n            .iter()\n            .filter_map(|item| match parse_turn_item(item) {\n                Some(TurnItem::UserMessage(user_message)) =&gt; Some(user_message),\n                _ =&gt; None,\n            })\n            .map(|user_message| user_message.message())\n            .collect::&lt;Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt;();\n        match run_turn(\n            Arc::clone(&amp;sess),\n            Arc::clone(&amp;turn_context),\n            Arc::clone(&amp;turn_diff_tracker),\n            turn_input,\n            cancellation_token.child_token(),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            Ok(turn_output) =&gt; {\n                let TurnRunResult {\n                    processed_items,\n                    total_token_usage,\n                } = turn_output;\n                let limit = turn_context\n                    .client\n                    .get_model_family()\n                    .auto_compact_token_limit()\n                    .unwrap_or(i64::MAX);\n                let total_usage_tokens = total_token_usage\n                    .as_ref()\n                    .map(TokenUsage::tokens_in_context_window);\n                let token_limit_reached = total_usage_tokens\n                    .map(|tokens| tokens &gt;= limit)\n                    .unwrap_or(false);\n                let (responses, items_to_record_in_conversation_history) =\n                    process_items(processed_items, &amp;sess, &amp;turn_context).await;\n\n                if token_limit_reached {\n                    if auto_compact_recently_attempted {\n                        let limit_str = limit.to_string();\n                        let current_tokens = total_usage_tokens\n                            .map(|tokens| tokens.to_string())\n                            .unwrap_or_else(|| \"unknown\".to_string());\n                        let event = EventMsg::Error(ErrorEvent {\n                            message: format!(\n                                \"Conversation is still above the token limit after automatic summarization (limit {limit_str}, current {current_tokens}). Please start a new session or trim your input.\"\n                            ),\n                        });\n                        sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, event).await;\n                        break;\n                    }\n                    auto_compact_recently_attempted = true;\n                    compact::run_inline_auto_compact_task(sess.clone(), turn_context.clone()).await;\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                auto_compact_recently_attempted = false;\n\n                if responses.is_empty() {\n                    last_agent_message = get_last_assistant_message_from_turn(\n                        &amp;items_to_record_in_conversation_history,\n                    );\n                    sess.notifier()\n                        .notify(&amp;UserNotification::AgentTurnComplete {\n                            thread_id: sess.conversation_id.to_string(),\n                            turn_id: turn_context.sub_id.clone(),\n                            cwd: turn_context.cwd.display().to_string(),\n                            input_messages: turn_input_messages,\n                            last_assistant_message: last_agent_message.clone(),\n                        });\n                    break;\n                }\n                continue;\n            }\n            Err(CodexErr::TurnAborted {\n                dangling_artifacts: processed_items,\n            }) =&gt; {\n                let _ = process_items(processed_items, &amp;sess, &amp;turn_context).await;\n                // Aborted turn is reported via a different event.\n                break;\n            }\n            Err(e) =&gt; {\n                info!(\"Turn error: {e:#}\");\n                let event = EventMsg::Error(ErrorEvent {\n                    message: e.to_string(),\n                });\n                sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, event).await;\n                // let the user continue the conversation\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    last_agent_message\n}\n\nasync fn run_turn(\n    sess: Arc&lt;Session&gt;,\n    turn_context: Arc&lt;TurnContext&gt;,\n    turn_diff_tracker: SharedTurnDiffTracker,\n    input: Vec&lt;ResponseItem&gt;,\n    cancellation_token: CancellationToken,\n) -&gt; CodexResult&lt;TurnRunResult&gt; {\n    let mcp_tools = sess.services.mcp_connection_manager.list_all_tools();\n    let router = Arc::new(ToolRouter::from_config(\n        &amp;turn_context.tools_config,\n        Some(mcp_tools),\n    ));\n\n    let model_supports_parallel = turn_context\n        .client\n        .get_model_family()\n        .supports_parallel_tool_calls;\n    let parallel_tool_calls = model_supports_parallel &amp;&amp; sess.enabled(Feature::ParallelToolCalls);\n    let prompt = Prompt {\n        input,\n        tools: router.specs(),\n        parallel_tool_calls,\n        base_instructions_override: turn_context.base_instructions.clone(),\n        output_schema: turn_context.final_output_json_schema.clone(),\n    };\n\n    let mut retries = 0;\n    loop {\n        match try_run_turn(\n            Arc::clone(&amp;router),\n            Arc::clone(&amp;sess),\n            Arc::clone(&amp;turn_context),\n            Arc::clone(&amp;turn_diff_tracker),\n            &amp;prompt,\n            cancellation_token.child_token(),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            Ok(output) =&gt; return Ok(output),\n            Err(CodexErr::TurnAborted {\n                dangling_artifacts: processed_items,\n            }) =&gt; {\n                return Err(CodexErr::TurnAborted {\n                    dangling_artifacts: processed_items,\n                });\n            }\n            Err(CodexErr::Interrupted) =&gt; return Err(CodexErr::Interrupted),\n            Err(CodexErr::EnvVar(var)) =&gt; return Err(CodexErr::EnvVar(var)),\n            Err(e @ CodexErr::Fatal(_)) =&gt; return Err(e),\n            Err(e @ CodexErr::ContextWindowExceeded) =&gt; {\n                sess.set_total_tokens_full(&amp;turn_context).await;\n                return Err(e);\n            }\n            Err(CodexErr::UsageLimitReached(e)) =&gt; {\n                let rate_limits = e.rate_limits.clone();\n                if let Some(rate_limits) = rate_limits {\n                    sess.update_rate_limits(&amp;turn_context, rate_limits).await;\n                }\n                return Err(CodexErr::UsageLimitReached(e));\n            }\n            Err(CodexErr::UsageNotIncluded) =&gt; return Err(CodexErr::UsageNotIncluded),\n            Err(e @ CodexErr::QuotaExceeded) =&gt; return Err(e),\n            Err(e @ CodexErr::RefreshTokenFailed(_)) =&gt; return Err(e),\n            Err(e) =&gt; {\n                // Use the configured provider-specific stream retry budget.\n                let max_retries = turn_context.client.get_provider().stream_max_retries();\n                if retries &lt; max_retries {\n                    retries += 1;\n                    let delay = match e {\n                        CodexErr::Stream(_, Some(delay)) =&gt; delay,\n                        _ =&gt; backoff(retries),\n                    };\n                    warn!(\n                        \"stream disconnected - retrying turn ({retries}/{max_retries} in {delay:?})...\",\n                    );\n\n                    // Surface retry information to any UI/front‑end so the\n                    // user understands what is happening instead of staring\n                    // at a seemingly frozen screen.\n                    sess.notify_stream_error(\n                        &amp;turn_context,\n                        format!(\"Reconnecting... {retries}/{max_retries}\"),\n                    )\n                    .await;\n\n                    tokio::time::sleep(delay).await;\n                } else {\n                    return Err(e);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// When the model is prompted, it returns a stream of events. Some of these\n/// events map to a &#96;ResponseItem&#96;. A &#96;ResponseItem&#96; may need to be\n/// \"handled\" such that it produces a &#96;ResponseInputItem&#96; that needs to be\n/// sent back to the model on the next turn.\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct ProcessedResponseItem {\n    pub item: ResponseItem,\n    pub response: Option&lt;ResponseInputItem&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\nstruct TurnRunResult {\n    processed_items: Vec&lt;ProcessedResponseItem&gt;,\n    total_token_usage: Option&lt;TokenUsage&gt;,\n}\n\n#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]\nasync fn try_run_turn(\n    router: Arc&lt;ToolRouter&gt;,\n    sess: Arc&lt;Session&gt;,\n    turn_context: Arc&lt;TurnContext&gt;,\n    turn_diff_tracker: SharedTurnDiffTracker,\n    prompt: &amp;Prompt,\n    cancellation_token: CancellationToken,\n) -&gt; CodexResult&lt;TurnRunResult&gt; {\n    let rollout_item = RolloutItem::TurnContext(TurnContextItem {\n        cwd: turn_context.cwd.clone(),\n        approval_policy: turn_context.approval_policy,\n        sandbox_policy: turn_context.sandbox_policy.clone(),\n        model: turn_context.client.get_model(),\n        effort: turn_context.client.get_reasoning_effort(),\n        summary: turn_context.client.get_reasoning_summary(),\n    });\n\n    sess.persist_rollout_items(&amp;[rollout_item]).await;\n    let mut stream = turn_context\n        .client\n        .clone()\n        .stream(prompt)\n        .or_cancel(&amp;cancellation_token)\n        .await??;\n\n    let tool_runtime = ToolCallRuntime::new(\n        Arc::clone(&amp;router),\n        Arc::clone(&amp;sess),\n        Arc::clone(&amp;turn_context),\n        Arc::clone(&amp;turn_diff_tracker),\n    );\n    let mut output: FuturesOrdered&lt;BoxFuture&lt;CodexResult&lt;ProcessedResponseItem&gt;&gt;&gt; =\n        FuturesOrdered::new();\n\n    let mut active_item: Option&lt;TurnItem&gt; = None;\n\n    loop {\n        // Poll the next item from the model stream. We must inspect *both* Ok and Err\n        // cases so that transient stream failures (e.g., dropped SSE connection before\n        // &#96;response.completed&#96;) bubble up and trigger the caller's retry logic.\n        let event = match stream.next().or_cancel(&amp;cancellation_token).await {\n            Ok(event) =&gt; event,\n            Err(cancel_err) =&gt; {\n                let processed_items = output.try_collect().await?;\n                // zapabob: CancelErrがstructに変更されたため、dangling_artifactsを取得\n                let _dangling = cancel_err.dangling_artifacts.unwrap_or_default();\n                return Err(CodexErr::TurnAborted {\n                    dangling_artifacts: processed_items,\n                });\n            }\n        };\n\n        let event = match event {\n            Some(res) =&gt; res?,\n            None =&gt; {\n                return Err(CodexErr::Stream(\n                    \"stream closed before response.completed\".into(),\n                    None,\n                ));\n            }\n        };\n\n        let add_completed = &amp;mut |response_item: ProcessedResponseItem| {\n            output.push_back(future::ready(Ok(response_item)).boxed());\n        };\n\n        match event {\n            ResponseEvent::Created =&gt; {}\n            ResponseEvent::OutputItemDone(item) =&gt; {\n                let previously_active_item = active_item.take();\n                match ToolRouter::build_tool_call(sess.as_ref(), item.clone()) {\n                    Ok(Some(call)) =&gt; {\n                        let payload_preview = call.payload.log_payload().into_owned();\n                        tracing::info!(\"ToolCall: {} {}\", call.tool_name, payload_preview);\n\n                        let response =\n                            tool_runtime.handle_tool_call(call, cancellation_token.child_token());\n\n                        output.push_back(\n                            async move {\n                                Ok(ProcessedResponseItem {\n                                    item,\n                                    response: Some(response.await?),\n                                })\n                            }\n                            .boxed(),\n                        );\n                    }\n                    Ok(None) =&gt; {\n                        if let Some(turn_item) = handle_non_tool_response_item(&amp;item).await {\n                            if previously_active_item.is_none() {\n                                sess.emit_turn_item_started(&amp;turn_context, &amp;turn_item).await;\n                            }\n\n                            sess.emit_turn_item_completed(&amp;turn_context, turn_item)\n                                .await;\n                        }\n\n                        add_completed(ProcessedResponseItem {\n                            item,\n                            response: None,\n                        });\n                    }\n                    Err(FunctionCallError::MissingLocalShellCallId) =&gt; {\n                        let msg = \"LocalShellCall without call_id or id\";\n                        turn_context\n                            .client\n                            .get_otel_event_manager()\n                            .log_tool_failed(\"local_shell\", msg);\n                        error!(msg);\n\n                        let response = ResponseInputItem::FunctionCallOutput {\n                            call_id: String::new(),\n                            output: FunctionCallOutputPayload {\n                                content: msg.to_string(),\n                                ..Default::default()\n                            },\n                        };\n                        add_completed(ProcessedResponseItem {\n                            item,\n                            response: Some(response),\n                        });\n                    }\n                    Err(FunctionCallError::RespondToModel(message))\n                    | Err(FunctionCallError::Denied(message)) =&gt; {\n                        let response = ResponseInputItem::FunctionCallOutput {\n                            call_id: String::new(),\n                            output: FunctionCallOutputPayload {\n                                content: message,\n                                ..Default::default()\n                            },\n                        };\n                        add_completed(ProcessedResponseItem {\n                            item,\n                            response: Some(response),\n                        });\n                    }\n                    Err(FunctionCallError::Fatal(message)) =&gt; {\n                        return Err(CodexErr::Fatal(message));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            ResponseEvent::OutputItemAdded(item) =&gt; {\n                if let Some(turn_item) = handle_non_tool_response_item(&amp;item).await {\n                    let tracked_item = turn_item.clone();\n                    sess.emit_turn_item_started(&amp;turn_context, &amp;turn_item).await;\n\n                    active_item = Some(tracked_item);\n                }\n            }\n            ResponseEvent::RateLimits(snapshot) =&gt; {\n                // Update internal state with latest rate limits, but defer sending until\n                // token usage is available to avoid duplicate TokenCount events.\n                sess.update_rate_limits(&amp;turn_context, snapshot).await;\n            }\n            ResponseEvent::Completed {\n                response_id: _,\n                token_usage,\n            } =&gt; {\n                sess.update_token_usage_info(&amp;turn_context, token_usage.as_ref())\n                    .await;\n                let processed_items = output.try_collect().await?;\n                let unified_diff = {\n                    let mut tracker = turn_diff_tracker.lock().await;\n                    tracker.get_unified_diff()\n                };\n                if let Ok(Some(unified_diff)) = unified_diff {\n                    let msg = EventMsg::TurnDiff(TurnDiffEvent { unified_diff });\n                    sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, msg).await;\n                }\n\n                let result = TurnRunResult {\n                    processed_items,\n                    total_token_usage: token_usage.clone(),\n                };\n\n                return Ok(result);\n            }\n            ResponseEvent::OutputTextDelta(delta) =&gt; {\n                // In review child threads, suppress assistant text deltas; the\n                // UI will show a selection popup from the final ReviewOutput.\n                if let Some(active) = active_item.as_ref() {\n                    let event = AgentMessageContentDeltaEvent {\n                        thread_id: sess.conversation_id.to_string(),\n                        turn_id: turn_context.sub_id.clone(),\n                        item_id: active.id(),\n                        delta: delta.clone(),\n                    };\n                    sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, EventMsg::AgentMessageContentDelta(event))\n                        .await;\n                } else {\n                    error_or_panic(\"ReasoningSummaryDelta without active item\".to_string());\n                }\n            }\n            ResponseEvent::ReasoningSummaryDelta(delta) =&gt; {\n                if let Some(active) = active_item.as_ref() {\n                    let event = ReasoningContentDeltaEvent {\n                        thread_id: sess.conversation_id.to_string(),\n                        turn_id: turn_context.sub_id.clone(),\n                        item_id: active.id(),\n                        delta: delta.clone(),\n                    };\n                    sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, EventMsg::ReasoningContentDelta(event))\n                        .await;\n                } else {\n                    error_or_panic(\"ReasoningSummaryDelta without active item\".to_string());\n                }\n            }\n            ResponseEvent::ReasoningSummaryPartAdded =&gt; {\n                let event =\n                    EventMsg::AgentReasoningSectionBreak(AgentReasoningSectionBreakEvent {});\n                sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, event).await;\n            }\n            ResponseEvent::ReasoningContentDelta(delta) =&gt; {\n                if let Some(active) = active_item.as_ref() {\n                    let event = ReasoningRawContentDeltaEvent {\n                        thread_id: sess.conversation_id.to_string(),\n                        turn_id: turn_context.sub_id.clone(),\n                        item_id: active.id(),\n                        delta: delta.clone(),\n                    };\n                    sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, EventMsg::ReasoningRawContentDelta(event))\n                        .await;\n                } else {\n                    error_or_panic(\"ReasoningRawContentDelta without active item\".to_string());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nasync fn handle_non_tool_response_item(item: &amp;ResponseItem) -&gt; Option&lt;TurnItem&gt; {\n    debug!(?item, \"Output item\");\n\n    match item {\n        ResponseItem::Message { .. }\n        | ResponseItem::Reasoning { .. }\n        | ResponseItem::WebSearchCall { .. } =&gt; parse_turn_item(item),\n        ResponseItem::FunctionCallOutput { .. } | ResponseItem::CustomToolCallOutput { .. } =&gt; {\n            debug!(\"unexpected tool output from stream\");\n            None\n        }\n        _ =&gt; None,\n    }\n}\n\npub(super) fn get_last_assistant_message_from_turn(responses: &amp;[ResponseItem]) -&gt; Option&lt;String&gt; {\n    responses.iter().rev().find_map(|item| {\n        if let ResponseItem::Message { role, content, .. } = item {\n            if role == \"assistant\" {\n                content.iter().rev().find_map(|ci| {\n                    if let ContentItem::OutputText { text } = ci {\n                        Some(text.clone())\n                    } else {\n                        None\n                    }\n                })\n            } else {\n                None\n            }\n        } else {\n            None\n        }\n    })\n}\n\nfn mcp_init_error_display(\n    server_name: &amp;str,\n    entry: Option&lt;&amp;McpAuthStatusEntry&gt;,\n    err: &amp;anyhow::Error,\n) -&gt; String {\n    if let Some(McpServerTransportConfig::StreamableHttp {\n        url,\n        bearer_token_env_var,\n        http_headers,\n        ..\n    }) = &amp;entry.map(|entry| &amp;entry.config.transport)\n        &amp;&amp; url == \"https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/\"\n        &amp;&amp; bearer_token_env_var.is_none()\n        &amp;&amp; http_headers.as_ref().map(HashMap::is_empty).unwrap_or(true)\n    {\n        // GitHub only supports OAUth for first party MCP clients.\n        // That means that the user has to specify a personal access token either via bearer_token_env_var or http_headers.\n        // https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/issues/921#issuecomment-3221026448\n        format!(\n            \"GitHub MCP does not support OAuth. Log in by adding a personal access token (https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens) to your environment and config.toml:\\n[mcp_servers.{server_name}]\\nbearer_token_env_var = CODEX_GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN\"\n        )\n    } else if is_mcp_client_auth_required_error(err) {\n        format!(\n            \"The {server_name} MCP server is not logged in. Run &#96;codex mcp login {server_name}&#96;.\"\n        )\n    } else if is_mcp_client_startup_timeout_error(err) {\n        let startup_timeout_secs = match entry {\n            Some(entry) =&gt; match entry.config.startup_timeout_sec {\n                Some(timeout) =&gt; timeout,\n                None =&gt; DEFAULT_STARTUP_TIMEOUT,\n            },\n            None =&gt; DEFAULT_STARTUP_TIMEOUT,\n        }\n        .as_secs();\n        format!(\n            \"MCP client for &#96;{server_name}&#96; timed out after {startup_timeout_secs} seconds. Add or adjust &#96;startup_timeout_sec&#96; in your config.toml:\\n[mcp_servers.{server_name}]\\nstartup_timeout_sec = XX\"\n        )\n    } else {\n        format!(\"MCP client for &#96;{server_name}&#96; failed to start: {err:#}\")\n    }\n}\n\nfn is_mcp_client_auth_required_error(error: &amp;anyhow::Error) -&gt; bool {\n    // StreamableHttpError::AuthRequired from the MCP SDK.\n    error.to_string().contains(\"Auth required\")\n}\n\nfn is_mcp_client_startup_timeout_error(error: &amp;anyhow::Error) -&gt; bool {\n    let error_message = error.to_string();\n    error_message.contains(\"request timed out\")\n        || error_message.contains(\"timed out handshaking with MCP server\")\n}\n\nuse crate::features::Features;\n#[cfg(test)]\npub(crate) use full_path = if p.is_relative() {\n            cwd.join(p)\n        } else {\n            p.to_path_buf()\n        };\n\n        let contents = std::fs::read_to_string(&amp;full_path).map_err(|e| {\n            std::io::Error::new(\n                e.kind(),\n                format!(\"failed to read {description} {}: {e}\", full_path.display()),\n            )\n        })?;\n\n        let s = contents.trim().to_string();\n        if s.is_empty() {\n            Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                format!(\"{description} is empty: {}\", full_path.display()),\n            ))\n        } else {\n            Ok(Some(s))\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn default_review_model() -&gt; String {\n    OPENAI_DEFAULT_REVIEW_MODEL.to_string()\n}\n\n/// cwd: &amp;Path,\n        description: &amp;str,\n    ) -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;Option&lt;String&gt;&gt; {\n        let Some(p) = path else {\n            return Ok(None);\n        };\n\n        let full_path = if p.is_relative() {\n            cwd.join(p)\n        } else {\n            p.to_path_buf()\n        };\n\n        let contents = std::fs::read_to_string(&amp;full_path).map_err(|e| {\n            std::io::Error::new(\n                e.kind(),\n                format!(\"failed to read {description} {}: {e}\", full_path.display()),\n            )\n        })?;\n\n        let s = contents.trim().to_string();\n        if s.is_empty() {\n            Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,\n                format!(\"{description} is empty: {}\", full_path.display()),\n            ))\n        } else {\n            Ok(Some(s))\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn default_review_model() -&gt; String {\n    OPENAI_DEFAULT_REVIEW_MODEL.to_string()\n}\n\n/// for UserSavedConfig {\n    fn from(config_toml: ConfigToml) -&gt; Self {\n        let profiles = config_toml\n            .profiles\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|(k, v)| (k, v.into()))\n            .collect();\n\n        Self {\n            approval_policy: config_toml.approval_policy,\n            sandbox_mode: config_toml.sandbox_mode,\n            sandbox_settings: config_toml.sandbox_workspace_write.map(From::from),\n            forced_chatgpt_workspace_id: config_toml.forced_chatgpt_workspace_id,\n            forced_login_method: config_toml.forced_login_method,\n            model: config_toml.model,\n            model_reasoning_effort: config_toml.model_reasoning_effort,\n            model_reasoning_summary: config_toml.model_reasoning_summary,\n            model_verbosity: config_toml.model_verbosity,\n            tools: config_toml.tools.map(From::from),\n            profile: config_toml.profile,\n            profiles,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ProjectConfig {\n    pub trust_level: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl ProjectConfig {\n    pub fn is_trusted(&amp;self) -&gt; SandboxPolicyResolution {\n        let resolved_sandbox_mode = sandbox_mode_override\n            .or(profile_sandbox_mode)\n            .or(self.sandbox_mode)\n            .or_else(|| {\n                // if no sandbox_mode is set, but user has marked directory as trusted, use WorkspaceWrite\n                self.get_active_project(resolved_cwd).and_then(|p| {\n                    if p.is_trusted() {\n                        Some(SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite)\n                    } else {\n                        None\n                    }\n                })\n            })\n            .unwrap_or(SandboxMode::DangerFullAccess); // YOLO mode: default to full access\n        let mut sandbox_policy = match resolved_sandbox_mode {\n            SandboxMode::ReadOnly =&gt; SandboxPolicy::new_read_only_policy(),\n            SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite =&gt; match self.sandbox_workspace_write.as_ref() {\n                Some(SandboxWorkspaceWrite {\n                    writable_roots,\n                    network_access,\n                    exclude_tmpdir_env_var,\n                    exclude_slash_tmp,\n                }) =&gt; SandboxPolicy::WorkspaceWrite {\n                    writable_roots: writable_roots.clone(),\n                    network_access: *network_access,\n                    exclude_tmpdir_env_var: *exclude_tmpdir_env_var,\n                    exclude_slash_tmp: *exclude_slash_tmp,\n                },\n                None =&gt; SandboxPolicy::new_workspace_write_policy(),\n            },\n            SandboxMode::DangerFullAccess =&gt; SandboxPolicy::DangerFullAccess,\n        };\n        let mut forced_auto_mode_downgraded_on_windows = false;\n        if cfg!(target_os = \"windows\")\n            &amp;&amp; matches!(resolved_sandbox_mode, SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite)\n            // If the experimental Windows sandbox is enabled, do not force a downgrade.\n            &amp;&amp; crate::safety::get_platform_sandbox().is_none()\n        {\n            sandbox_policy = SandboxPolicy::new_read_only_policy();\n            forced_auto_mode_downgraded_on_windows = true;\n        }\n        SandboxPolicyResolution {\n            policy: sandbox_policy,\n            forced_auto_mode_downgraded_on_windows,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Resolves the cwd to an existing project, or returns None if ConfigToml\n    /// does not contain a project corresponding to cwd or a git repo for cwd\n    pub fn get_active_project(&amp;self, resolved_cwd: &amp;Path) -&gt; Option&lt;ProjectConfig&gt; {\n        let projects = self.projects.clone().unwrap_or_default();\n\n        if let Some(project_config) = projects.get(&amp;resolved_cwd.to_string_lossy().to_string()) {\n            return Some(project_config.clone());\n        }\n\n        // If cwd lives inside a git repo/worktree, check whether the root git project\n        // (the primary repository working directory) is trusted. This lets\n        // worktrees inherit trust from the main project.\n        if let Some(repo_root) = resolve_root_git_project_for_trust(resolved_cwd)\n            &amp;&amp; let Some(project_config_for_root) =\n                projects.get(&amp;repo_root.to_string_lossy().to_string_lossy().to_string())\n        {\n            return Some(project_config_for_root.clone());\n        }\n\n        None\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_config_profile(\n        &amp;self,\n        override_profile: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;ConfigProfile, std::io::Error&gt; {\n        let profile = override_profile.or_else(|| self.profile.clone());\n\n        match profile {\n            Some(key) =&gt; {\n                if let Some(profile) = self.profiles.get(key.as_str()) {\n profile &#96;{key}&#96; not found\"),\n                ))\n            }\n            None =&gt; Ok(ConfigProfile::default()),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Optional overrides for user configuration base_instructions,\n            developer_instructions,\n            compact_prompt,\n            include_apply_patch_tool: include_apply_patch_tool_override,\n            show_raw_agent_reasoning,\n            tools_web_search_request: override_tools_web_search_request,\n            additional_writable_roots,\n            development_mode: _development_mode_override,\n        } = overrides;\n\n        let active_profile_name = config_profile_key\n            .as_ref()\n            .or(cfg.profile.as_ref())\n            .cloned();\n        let config_profile = match active_profile_name.as_ref() {\n            Some(key) =&gt; cfg\n                .profiles\n                .get(key)\n                .ok_or_else(|| {\n                    std::io::Error::new(\n                        std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound,\n                        format!(\"config profile &#96;{key}&#96; not found\"),\n                    )\n                })?\n                .clone(),\n            None =&gt; ConfigProfile::default(),\n        };\n\n        let feature_overrides = FeatureOverrides {\n            include_apply_patch_tool: include_apply_patch_tool_override,\n            web_search_request: override_tools_web_search_request,\n        };\n\n        let features = Features::from_config(&amp;cfg, &amp;config_profile, feature_overrides);\n        #[cfg(target_os = \"windows\")]\n        {\n            crate::safety::set_windows_sandbox_enabled(features.enabled(Feature::WindowsSandbox));\n        }\n\n        let resolved_cwd = {\n            use std::env;\n\n Some(p) if p.is_absolute() =&gt; p,\n                Some(p) =&gt; {\n                    // Resolve relative path against the current working directory.\n                    tracing::info!(\"cwd is relative, resolving against current dir\");\n                    let mut current = env::current_dir()?;\n                    current.push(p);\n                    current\n                }\n model = model\n            .or(config_profile.model)\n            .or(cfg.model)\n            .unwrap_or_else(default_model);\n\n        let mut model_family =\n            find_family_for_model(&amp;model).unwrap_or_else(|| derive_default_model_family(&amp;model));\n\n        if let Some(supports_reasoning_summaries) = cfg.model_supports_reasoning_summaries {\n            model_family.supports_reasoning_summaries = supports_reasoning_summaries;\n        }\n        if let Some(model_reasoning_summary_format) = cfg.model_reasoning_summary_format {\n            model_family.reasoning_summary_format = model_reasoning_summary_format;\n        }\n\n        let openai_model_info = get_model_info(&amp;model_family);\n        let model_context_window = cfg\n compact_prompt = compact_prompt.or(cfg.compact_prompt).and_then(|value| {\n            let trimmed = value.trim();\n            if trimmed.is_empty() {\n                None\n            } else {\n -&gt; Option&lt;String&gt; {\n        let base = codex_dir?;\n        for candidate in [LOCAL_PROJECT_DOC_FILENAME, DEFAULT_PROJECT_DOC_FILENAME] {\n            let mut path = base.to_path_buf();\n for UserSavedConfig {\n    fn from(config_toml: ConfigToml) -&gt; Self {\n        let profiles = config_toml\n            .profiles\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|(k, v)| (k, v.into()))\n            .collect();\n\n        Self {\n            approval_policy: config_toml.approval_policy,\n            sandbox_mode: config_toml.sandbox_mode,\n            sandbox_settings: config_toml.sandbox_workspace_write.map(From::from),\n            forced_chatgpt_workspace_id: config_toml.forced_chatgpt_workspace_id,\n            forced_login_method: config_toml.forced_login_method,\n            model: config_toml.model,\n            model_reasoning_effort: config_toml.model_reasoning_effort,\n            model_reasoning_summary: config_toml.model_reasoning_summary,\n            model_verbosity: config_toml.model_verbosity,\n            tools: config_toml.tools.map(From::from),\n            profile: config_toml.profile,\n            profiles,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ProjectConfig {\n    pub trust_level: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl ProjectConfig {\n    pub fn is_trusted(&amp;self) -&gt; bool {\n        match &amp;self.trust_level {\n            Some(trust_level) =&gt; trust_level == \"trusted\",\n            None =&gt; false,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Deserialize, Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq)]\npub struct ToolsToml {\n    #[serde(default, alias = \"web_search_request\")]\n    pub web_search: Option&lt;bool&gt;,\n\n    /// Enable the &#96;view_image&#96; SandboxPolicyResolution {\n        let resolved_sandbox_mode = sandbox_mode_override\n            .or(profile_sandbox_mode)\n            .or(self.sandbox_mode)\n            .or_else(|| {\n                // if no sandbox_mode is set, but user has marked directory as trusted, use WorkspaceWrite\n                self.get_active_project(resolved_cwd).and_then(|p| {\n                    if p.is_trusted() {\n                        Some(SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite)\n                    } else {\n                        None\n                    }\n                })\n            })\n            .unwrap_or(SandboxMode::DangerFullAccess); // YOLO mode: default to full access\n        let mut sandbox_policy = match resolved_sandbox_mode {\n            SandboxMode::ReadOnly =&gt; SandboxPolicy::new_read_only_policy(),\n            SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite =&gt; match self.sandbox_workspace_write.as_ref() {\n                Some(SandboxWorkspaceWrite {\n                    writable_roots,\n                    network_access,\n                    exclude_tmpdir_env_var,\n                    exclude_slash_tmp,\n                }) =&gt; SandboxPolicy::WorkspaceWrite {\n                    writable_roots: writable_roots.clone(),\n                    network_access: *network_access,\n                    exclude_tmpdir_env_var: *exclude_tmpdir_env_var,\n                    exclude_slash_tmp: *exclude_slash_tmp,\n                },\n                None =&gt; SandboxPolicy::new_workspace_write_policy(),\n            },\n            SandboxMode::DangerFullAccess =&gt; SandboxPolicy::DangerFullAccess,\n        };\n        let mut forced_auto_mode_downgraded_on_windows = false;\n        if cfg!(target_os = \"windows\")\n            &amp;&amp; matches!(resolved_sandbox_mode, SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite)\n            // If the experimental Windows sandbox is enabled, do not force a downgrade.\n            &amp;&amp; crate::safety::get_platform_sandbox().is_none()\n        {\n            sandbox_policy = SandboxPolicy::new_read_only_policy();\n            forced_auto_mode_downgraded_on_windows = true;\n        }\n        SandboxPolicyResolution {\n            policy: sandbox_policy,\n            forced_auto_mode_downgraded_on_windows,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Resolves the cwd to an existing project, or returns None if ConfigToml\n    /// does not contain a project corresponding to cwd or a git repo for cwd\n    pub fn get_active_project(&amp;self, resolved_cwd: &amp;Path) -&gt; Option&lt;ProjectConfig&gt; {\n        let projects = self.projects.clone().unwrap_or_default();\n\n        if let Some(project_config) = projects.get(&amp;resolved_cwd.to_string_lossy().to_string()) {\n            return Some(project_config.clone());\n        }\n\n        // If cwd lives inside a git repo/worktree, check whether the root git project\n        // (the primary repository working directory) is trusted. This lets\n        // worktrees inherit trust from the main project.\n        if let Some(repo_root) = resolve_root_git_project_for_trust(resolved_cwd)\n            &amp;&amp; let Some(project_config_for_root) =\n                projects.get(&amp;repo_root.to_string_lossy().to_string_lossy().to_string())\n        {\n            return Some(project_config_for_root.clone());\n        }\n\n        None\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_config_profile(\n        &amp;self,\n        override_profile: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;ConfigProfile, std::io::Error&gt; {\n        let profile = override_profile.or_else(|| self.profile.clone());\n\n        match profile {\n            Some(key) =&gt; {\n                if let Some(profile) = self.profiles.get(key.as_str()) {\n                    return Ok(profile.clone());\n                }\n\n                Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                    std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound,\n                    format!(\"config profile &#96;{key}&#96; not found\"),\n                ))\n            }\n            None =&gt; Ok(ConfigProfile::default()),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Optional overrides for user configuration Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n    pub approval_policy: Option&lt;AskForApproval&gt;,\n    pub sandbox_mode: Option&lt;SandboxMode&gt;,\n    pub model_provider: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub config_profile: codex_home: PathBuf,\n    ) -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        let user_instructions = Self::load_instructions(Some(&amp;codex_home));\n\n        // Destructure ConfigOverrides fully to ensure all overrides are applied.\n        let ConfigOverrides {\n            model,\n            review_model: override_review_model,\n            cwd,\n            approval_policy: base_instructions,\n            developer_instructions,\n            compact_prompt,\n            include_apply_patch_tool: include_apply_patch_tool_override,\n            show_raw_agent_reasoning,\n            tools_web_search_request: override_tools_web_search_request,\n            additional_writable_roots,\n            development_mode: _development_mode_override,\n        } = overrides;\n\n        let active_profile_name = config_profile_key\n            .as_ref()\n            .or(cfg.profile.as_ref())\n            .cloned();\n        let config_profile = match active_profile_name.as_ref() {\n            Some(key) =&gt; cfg\n                .profiles\n                .get(key)\n                .ok_or_else(|| {\n                    std::io::Error::new(\n                        std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound,\n                        format!(\"config profile &#96;{key}&#96; not found\"),\n                    )\n                })?\n                .clone(),\n            None =&gt; ConfigProfile::default(),\n        };\n\n        let feature_overrides = FeatureOverrides {\n            include_apply_patch_tool: include_apply_patch_tool_override,\n            web_search_request: override_tools_web_search_request,\n        };\n\n        let features = Features::from_config(&amp;cfg, &amp;config_profile, feature_overrides);\n        #[cfg(target_os = \"windows\")]\n        {\n            crate::safety::set_windows_sandbox_enabled(features.enabled(Feature::WindowsSandbox));\n        }\n\n        let resolved_cwd = {\n            use std::env;\n\n            match cwd {\n                None =&gt; {\n                    tracing::info!(\"cwd not set, using current dir\");\n                    env::current_dir()?\n                }\n                Some(p) if p.is_absolute() =&gt; p,\n                Some(p) =&gt; {\n                    // Resolve relative path against the current working directory.\n                    tracing::info!(\"cwd is relative, resolving against current dir\");\n                    let mut current = env::current_dir()?;\n                    current.push(p);\n                    current\n                }\n path.is_absolute() {\n                    path\n                } else {\n                    resolved_cwd.join(path)\n                };\n                match canonicalize(&amp;absolute) {\n       .unwrap_or_else(|| \"openai\".to_string());\n        let model_provider = model_providers\n            .get(&amp;model_provider_id)\n            .ok_or_else(|| {\n model = model\n            .or(config_profile.model)\n            .or(cfg.model)\n            .unwrap_or_else(default_model);\n\n        let mut model_family =\n            find_family_for_model(&amp;model).unwrap_or_else(|| derive_default_model_family(&amp;model));\n\n        if let Some(supports_reasoning_summaries) = cfg.model_supports_reasoning_summaries {\n            model_family.supports_reasoning_summaries = supports_reasoning_summaries;\n        }\n        if let Some(model_reasoning_summary_format) = cfg.model_reasoning_summary_format {\n            model_family.reasoning_summary_format = model_reasoning_summary_format;\n        }\n\n        let openai_model_info = get_model_info(&amp;model_family);\n        let model_context_window = cfg\n            .model_context_window\n            .or_else(|| openai_model_info.as_ref().map(|info| info.context_window));\n        let model_max_output_tokens = cfg.model_max_output_tokens.or_else(|| {\n            openai_model_info\n                .as_ref()\n                .map(|info| info.max_output_tokens)\n        });\n        let model_auto_compact_token_limit = cfg.model_auto_compact_token_limit.or_else(|| {\n            openai_model_info\n                .as_ref()\n                .and_then(|info| info.auto_compact_token_limit)\n        });\n\n        let compact_prompt = compact_prompt.or(cfg.compact_prompt).and_then(|value| {\n            let trimmed = value.trim();\n            if trimmed.is_empty() {\n                None\n            } else {\n If the\n        // path is relative, resolve it against the effective cwd so the\n        // behaviour matches other path-like config values.\n        let experimental_instructions_path = config_profile\n            .experimental_instructions_file\n            .as_ref()\n            .or(cfg.experimental_instructions_file.as_ref());\n        let file_base_instructions = Self::load_override_from_file(\n            experimental_instructions_path,\n            &amp;resolved_cwd,\n            \"experimental instructions file\",\n        )?;\n        let base_instructions = base_instructions.or(file_base_instructions);\n        let developer_instructions = developer_instructions.or(cfg.developer_instructions);\n\n        let experimental_compact_prompt_path = config_profile\n            .experimental_compact_prompt_file\n            .as_ref()\n            .or(cfg.experimental_compact_prompt_file.as_ref());\n        let file_compact_prompt = Self::load_override_from_file(\n            experimental_compact_prompt_path,\n            &amp;resolved_cwd,\n            \"experimental compact prompt file\",\n        )?;\n        let compact_prompt = compact_prompt.or(file_compact_prompt);\n\n        // Default review model when not set in config; allow CLI override to take precedence.\n        let review_model = override_review_model\n            .or(cfg.review_model)\n            .unwrap_or_else(default_review_model);\n\n        let config = Self {\n            model,\n            review_model,\n            model_family,\n            model_context_window,\n            model_max_output_tokens,\n            model_auto_compact_token_limit,\n            model_provider_id,\n            model_provider,\n            cwd: resolved_cwd,\n            approval_policy,\n            sandbox_policy,\n            did_user_set_custom_approval_policy_or_sandbox_mode,\n            forced_auto_mode_downgraded_on_windows,\n            shell_environment_policy,\n            notify: cfg.notify,\n            user_instructions,\n            base_instructions,\n            developer_instructions,\n            compact_prompt,\n            // The config.toml omits \"_mode\" because it's a config file. -&gt; Option&lt;String&gt; {\n        let base = codex_dir?;\n        for candidate in [LOCAL_PROJECT_DOC_FILENAME, DEFAULT_PROJECT_DOC_FILENAME] {\n            let mut path = base.to_path_buf();\n Returns the path to the Codex configuration directory, which can be\n/// specified by the &#96;CODEX_HOME&#96; environment variable. If not set, defaults to\n/// &#96;~/.codex&#96;.\n///\n/// - If &#96;CODEX_HOME&#96; is set, the value will be canonicalized and this\n///   function will Err if the path does not exist.\n/// - If &#96;CODEX_HOME&#96; is not set, this function does not verify that the\n///   directory exists.\npub fn find_codex_home() -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;PathBuf&gt; {\n    // Honor the &#96;CODEX_HOME&#96; environment variable when it is set to allow users\n    // (and tests) to override the default location.\n    if let Ok(val) = std::env::var(\"CODEX_HOME\")\n        &amp;&amp; !val.is_empty()\n    {\n        return PathBuf::from(val).canonicalize();\n    }\n\n    let mut p = home_dir().ok_or_else(|| {\n        std::io::Error::new(\n            std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound,\n            \"Could not find home directory\",\n        )\n    })?;\n    p.push(\".codex\");\n    Ok(p)\n}\n\n/// Returns the path to the folder where Codex logs are stored. Does not verify\n/// that the directory exists.\npub fn log_dir(cfg: &amp;Config) -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;PathBuf&gt; {\n    let mut p = cfg.codex_home.clone();\n    p.push(\"log\");\n for UserSavedConfig {\n    fn from(config_toml: ConfigToml) -&gt; Self {\n        let profiles = config_toml\n            .profiles\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|(k, v)| (k, v.into()))\n            .collect();\n\n        Self {\n            approval_policy: config_toml.approval_policy,\n            sandbox_mode: config_toml.sandbox_mode,\n            sandbox_settings: config_toml.sandbox_workspace_write.map(From::from),\n            forced_chatgpt_workspace_id: config_toml.forced_chatgpt_workspace_id,\n            forced_login_method: config_toml.forced_login_method,\n            model: config_toml.model,\n            model_reasoning_effort: config_toml.model_reasoning_effort,\n            model_reasoning_summary: config_toml.model_reasoning_summary,\n            model_verbosity: config_toml.model_verbosity,\n            tools: config_toml.tools.map(From::from),\n            profile: config_toml.profile,\n            profiles,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ProjectConfig {\n    pub trust_level: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl ProjectConfig {\n    pub fn is_trusted(&amp;self) -&gt; bool {\n        match &amp;self.trust_level {\n            Some(trust_level) =&gt; trust_level == \"trusted\",\n            None =&gt; false,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Deserialize, Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq)]\npub struct ToolsToml {\n    #[serde(default, alias = \"web_search_request\")]\n    pub web_search: Option&lt;bool&gt;,\n\n    /// Enable the &#96;view_image&#96; SandboxPolicyResolution {\n        let resolved_sandbox_mode = sandbox_mode_override\n            .or(profile_sandbox_mode)\n            .or(self.sandbox_mode)\n            .or_else(|| {\n                // if no sandbox_mode is set, but user has marked directory as trusted, use WorkspaceWrite\n                self.get_active_project(resolved_cwd).and_then(|p| {\n                    if p.is_trusted() {\n                        Some(SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite)\n                    } else {\n                        None\n                    }\n                })\n            })\n            .unwrap_or(SandboxMode::DangerFullAccess); // YOLO mode: default to full access\n        let mut sandbox_policy = match resolved_sandbox_mode {\n            SandboxMode::ReadOnly =&gt; SandboxPolicy::new_read_only_policy(),\n            SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite =&gt; match self.sandbox_workspace_write.as_ref() {\n                Some(SandboxWorkspaceWrite {\n                    writable_roots,\n                    network_access,\n                    exclude_tmpdir_env_var,\n                    exclude_slash_tmp,\n                }) =&gt; SandboxPolicy::WorkspaceWrite {\n                    writable_roots: writable_roots.clone(),\n                    network_access: *network_access,\n                    exclude_tmpdir_env_var: *exclude_tmpdir_env_var,\n                    exclude_slash_tmp: *exclude_slash_tmp,\n                },\n                None =&gt; SandboxPolicy::new_workspace_write_policy(),\n            },\n            SandboxMode::DangerFullAccess =&gt; SandboxPolicy::DangerFullAccess,\n        };\n        let mut forced_auto_mode_downgraded_on_windows = false;\n        if cfg!(target_os = \"windows\")\n            &amp;&amp; matches!(resolved_sandbox_mode, SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite)\n            // If the experimental Windows sandbox is enabled, do not force a downgrade.\n            &amp;&amp; crate::safety::get_platform_sandbox().is_none()\n        {\n            sandbox_policy = SandboxPolicy::new_read_only_policy();\n            forced_auto_mode_downgraded_on_windows = true;\n        }\n        SandboxPolicyResolution {\n            policy: sandbox_policy,\n            forced_auto_mode_downgraded_on_windows,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Resolves the cwd to an existing project, or returns None if ConfigToml\n    /// does not contain a project corresponding to cwd or a git repo for cwd\n    pub fn get_active_project(&amp;self, resolved_cwd: &amp;Path) -&gt; Option&lt;ProjectConfig&gt; {\n        let projects = self.projects.clone().unwrap_or_default();\n\n        if let Some(project_config) = projects.get(&amp;resolved_cwd.to_string_lossy().to_string()) {\n            return Some(project_config.clone());\n        }\n\n        // If cwd lives inside a git repo/worktree, check whether the root git project\n        // (the primary repository working directory) is trusted. This lets\n        // worktrees inherit trust from the main project.\n        if let Some(repo_root) = resolve_root_git_project_for_trust(resolved_cwd)\n            &amp;&amp; let Some(project_config_for_root) =\n                projects.get(&amp;repo_root.to_string_lossy().to_string_lossy().to_string())\n        {\n            return Some(project_config_for_root.clone());\n        }\n\n        None\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_config_profile(\n        &amp;self,\n        override_profile: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;ConfigProfile, std::io::Error&gt; {\n        let profile = override_profile.or_else(|| self.profile.clone());\n\n        match profile {\n            Some(key) =&gt; {\n                if let Some(profile) = self.profiles.get(key.as_str()) {\n                    return Ok(profile.clone());\n                }\n\n                Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                    std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound,\n                    format!(\"config profile &#96;{key}&#96; not found\"),\n                ))\n            }\n            None =&gt; Ok(ConfigProfile::default()),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Optional overrides for user configuration Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n    pub approval_policy: Option&lt;AskForApproval&gt;,\n    pub sandbox_mode: Option&lt;SandboxMode&gt;,\n    pub model_provider: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub config_profile: codex_home: PathBuf,\n    ) -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        let user_instructions = Self::load_instructions(Some(&amp;codex_home));\n\n        // Destructure ConfigOverrides fully to ensure all overrides are applied.\n        let ConfigOverrides {\n            model,\n            review_model: override_review_model,\n            cwd,\n            approval_policy: base_instructions,\n            developer_instructions,\n            compact_prompt,\n            include_apply_patch_tool: include_apply_patch_tool_override,\n            show_raw_agent_reasoning,\n            tools_web_search_request: override_tools_web_search_request,\n            additional_writable_roots,\n            development_mode: _development_mode_override,\n        } = overrides;\n\n        let active_profile_name = config_profile_key\n            .as_ref()\n            .or(cfg.profile.as_ref())\n            .cloned();\n        let config_profile = match active_profile_name.as_ref() {\n            Some(key) =&gt; cfg\n                .profiles\n                .get(key)\n                .ok_or_else(|| {\n                    std::io::Error::new(\n                        std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound,\n                        format!(\"config profile &#96;{key}&#96; not found\"),\n                    )\n                })?\n                .clone(),\n            None =&gt; ConfigProfile::default(),\n        };\n\n        let feature_overrides = FeatureOverrides {\n            include_apply_patch_tool: include_apply_patch_tool_override,\n            web_search_request: override_tools_web_search_request,\n        };\n\n        let features = Features::from_config(&amp;cfg, &amp;config_profile, feature_overrides);\n        #[cfg(target_os = \"windows\")]\n        {\n            crate::safety::set_windows_sandbox_enabled(features.enabled(Feature::WindowsSandbox));\n        }\n\n        let resolved_cwd = {\n            use std::env;\n\n            match cwd {\n                None =&gt; {\n                    tracing::info!(\"cwd not set, using current dir\");\n                    env::current_dir()?\n                }\n                Some(p) if p.is_absolute() =&gt; p,\n                Some(p) =&gt; {\n                    // Resolve relative path against the current working directory.\n                    tracing::info!(\"cwd is relative, resolving against current dir\");\n                    let mut current = env::current_dir()?;\n                    current.push(p);\n                    current\n                }\n path.is_absolute() {\n                    path\n                } else {\n                    resolved_cwd.join(path)\n                };\n                match canonicalize(&amp;absolute) {\n       .unwrap_or_else(|| \"openai\".to_string());\n        let model_provider = model_providers\n            .get(&amp;model_provider_id)\n            .ok_or_else(|| {\n model = model\n            .or(config_profile.model)\n            .or(cfg.model)\n            .unwrap_or_else(default_model);\n\n        let mut model_family =\n            find_family_for_model(&amp;model).unwrap_or_else(|| derive_default_model_family(&amp;model));\n\n        if let Some(supports_reasoning_summaries) = cfg.model_supports_reasoning_summaries {\n            model_family.supports_reasoning_summaries = supports_reasoning_summaries;\n        }\n        if let Some(model_reasoning_summary_format) = cfg.model_reasoning_summary_format {\n            model_family.reasoning_summary_format = model_reasoning_summary_format;\n        }\n\n        let openai_model_info = get_model_info(&amp;model_family);\n        let model_context_window = cfg\n            .model_context_window\n            .or_else(|| openai_model_info.as_ref().map(|info| info.context_window));\n        let model_max_output_tokens = cfg.model_max_output_tokens.or_else(|| {\n            openai_model_info\n                .as_ref()\n                .map(|info| info.max_output_tokens)\n        });\n        let model_auto_compact_token_limit = cfg.model_auto_compact_token_limit.or_else(|| {\n            openai_model_info\n                .as_ref()\n                .and_then(|info| info.auto_compact_token_limit)\n        });\n\n        let compact_prompt = compact_prompt.or(cfg.compact_prompt).and_then(|value| {\n            let trimmed = value.trim();\n            if trimmed.is_empty() {\n                None\n            } else {\n If the\n        // path is relative, resolve it against the effective cwd so the\n        // behaviour matches other path-like config values.\n        let experimental_instructions_path = config_profile\n            .experimental_instructions_file\n            .as_ref()\n            .or(cfg.experimental_instructions_file.as_ref());\n        let file_base_instructions = Self::load_override_from_file(\n            experimental_instructions_path,\n            &amp;resolved_cwd,\n            \"experimental instructions file\",\n        )?;\n        let base_instructions = base_instructions.or(file_base_instructions);\n        let developer_instructions = developer_instructions.or(cfg.developer_instructions);\n\n        let experimental_compact_prompt_path = config_profile\n            .experimental_compact_prompt_file\n            .as_ref()\n            .or(cfg.experimental_compact_prompt_file.as_ref());\n        let file_compact_prompt = Self::load_override_from_file(\n            experimental_compact_prompt_path,\n            &amp;resolved_cwd,\n            \"experimental compact prompt file\",\n        )?;\n        let compact_prompt = compact_prompt.or(file_compact_prompt);\n\n        // Default review model when not set in config; allow CLI override to take precedence.\n        let review_model = override_review_model\n            .or(cfg.review_model)\n            .unwrap_or_else(default_review_model);\n\n        let config = Self {\n            model,\n            review_model,\n            model_family,\n            model_context_window,\n            model_max_output_tokens,\n            model_auto_compact_token_limit,\n            model_provider_id,\n            model_provider,\n            cwd: resolved_cwd,\n            approval_policy,\n            sandbox_policy,\n            did_user_set_custom_approval_policy_or_sandbox_mode,\n            forced_auto_mode_downgraded_on_windows,\n            shell_environment_policy,\n            notify: cfg.notify,\n            user_instructions,\n            base_instructions,\n            developer_instructions,\n            compact_prompt,\n            // The config.toml omits \"_mode\" because it's a config file. -&gt; Option&lt;String&gt; {\n        let base = codex_dir?;\n        for candidate in [LOCAL_PROJECT_DOC_FILENAME, DEFAULT_PROJECT_DOC_FILENAME] {\n            let mut path = base.to_path_buf();\n Returns the path to the Codex configuration directory, which can be\n/// specified by the &#96;CODEX_HOME&#96; environment variable. If not set, defaults to\n/// &#96;~/.codex&#96;.\n///\n/// - If &#96;CODEX_HOME&#96; is set, the value will be canonicalized and this\n///   function will Err if the path does not exist.\n/// - If &#96;CODEX_HOME&#96; is not set, this function does not verify that the\n///   directory exists.\npub fn find_codex_home() -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;PathBuf&gt; {\n    // Honor the &#96;CODEX_HOME&#96; environment variable when it is set to allow users\n    // (and tests) to override the default location.\n    if let Ok(val) = std::env::var(\"CODEX_HOME\")\n        &amp;&amp; !val.is_empty()\n    {\n        return PathBuf::from(val).canonicalize();\n    }\n\n    let mut p = home_dir().ok_or_else(|| {\n        std::io::Error::new(\n            std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound,\n            \"Could not find home directory\",\n        )\n    })?;\n    p.push(\".codex\");\n    Ok(p)\n}\n\n/// Returns the path to the folder where Codex logs are stored. Does not verify\n/// that the directory exists.\npub fn log_dir(cfg: &amp;Config) -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;PathBuf&gt; {\n    let mut p = cfg.codex_home.clone();\n    p.push(\"log\");\n for UserSavedConfig {\n    fn from(config_toml: ConfigToml) -&gt; Self {\n        let profiles = config_toml\n            .profiles\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|(k, v)| (k, v.into()))\n            .collect();\n\n        Self {\n            approval_policy: config_toml.approval_policy,\n            sandbox_mode: config_toml.sandbox_mode,\n            sandbox_settings: config_toml.sandbox_workspace_write.map(From::from),\n            forced_chatgpt_workspace_id: config_toml.forced_chatgpt_workspace_id,\n            forced_login_method: config_toml.forced_login_method,\n            model: config_toml.model,\n            model_reasoning_effort: config_toml.model_reasoning_effort,\n            model_reasoning_summary: config_toml.model_reasoning_summary,\n            model_verbosity: config_toml.model_verbosity,\n            tools: config_toml.tools.map(From::from),\n            profile: config_toml.profile,\n            profiles,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ProjectConfig {\n    pub trust_level: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl ProjectConfig {\n    pub fn is_trusted(&amp;self) -&gt; bool {\n        match &amp;self.trust_level {\n            Some(trust_level) =&gt; trust_level == \"trusted\",\n            None =&gt; false,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Deserialize, Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq)]\npub struct ToolsToml {\n    #[serde(default, alias = \"web_search_request\")]\n    pub web_search: Option&lt;bool&gt;,\n\n    /// Enable the &#96;view_image&#96; SandboxPolicyResolution {\n        let resolved_sandbox_mode = sandbox_mode_override\n            .or(profile_sandbox_mode)\n            .or(self.sandbox_mode)\n            .or_else(|| {\n                // if no sandbox_mode is set, but user has marked directory as trusted, use WorkspaceWrite\n                self.get_active_project(resolved_cwd).and_then(|p| {\n                    if p.is_trusted() {\n                        Some(SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite)\n                    } else {\n                        None\n                    }\n                })\n            })\n            .unwrap_or(SandboxMode::DangerFullAccess); // YOLO mode: default to full access\n        let mut sandbox_policy = match resolved_sandbox_mode {\n            SandboxMode::ReadOnly =&gt; SandboxPolicy::new_read_only_policy(),\n            SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite =&gt; match self.sandbox_workspace_write.as_ref() {\n                Some(SandboxWorkspaceWrite {\n                    writable_roots,\n                    network_access,\n                    exclude_tmpdir_env_var,\n                    exclude_slash_tmp,\n                }) =&gt; SandboxPolicy::WorkspaceWrite {\n                    writable_roots: writable_roots.clone(),\n                    network_access: *network_access,\n                    exclude_tmpdir_env_var: *exclude_tmpdir_env_var,\n                    exclude_slash_tmp: *exclude_slash_tmp,\n                },\n                None =&gt; SandboxPolicy::new_workspace_write_policy(),\n            },\n            SandboxMode::DangerFullAccess =&gt; SandboxPolicy::DangerFullAccess,\n        };\n        let mut forced_auto_mode_downgraded_on_windows = false;\n        if cfg!(target_os = \"windows\")\n            &amp;&amp; matches!(resolved_sandbox_mode, SandboxMode::WorkspaceWrite)\n            // If the experimental Windows sandbox is enabled, do not force a downgrade.\n            &amp;&amp; crate::safety::get_platform_sandbox().is_none()\n        {\n            sandbox_policy = SandboxPolicy::new_read_only_policy();\n            forced_auto_mode_downgraded_on_windows = true;\n        }\n        SandboxPolicyResolution {\n            policy: sandbox_policy,\n            forced_auto_mode_downgraded_on_windows,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Resolves the cwd to an existing project, or returns None if ConfigToml\n    /// does not contain a project corresponding to cwd or a git repo for cwd\n    pub fn get_active_project(&amp;self, resolved_cwd: &amp;Path) -&gt; Option&lt;ProjectConfig&gt; {\n        let projects = self.projects.clone().unwrap_or_default();\n\n        if let Some(project_config) = projects.get(&amp;resolved_cwd.to_string_lossy().to_string()) {\n            return Some(project_config.clone());\n        }\n\n        // If cwd lives inside a git repo/worktree, check whether the root git project\n        // (the primary repository working directory) is trusted. This lets\n        // worktrees inherit trust from the main project.\n        if let Some(repo_root) = resolve_root_git_project_for_trust(resolved_cwd)\n            &amp;&amp; let Some(project_config_for_root) =\n                projects.get(&amp;repo_root.to_string_lossy().to_string_lossy().to_string())\n        {\n            return Some(project_config_for_root.clone());\n        }\n\n        None\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_config_profile(\n        &amp;self,\n        override_profile: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; Result&lt;ConfigProfile, std::io::Error&gt; {\n        let profile = override_profile.or_else(|| self.profile.clone());\n\n        match profile {\n            Some(key) =&gt; {\n                if let Some(profile) = self.profiles.get(key.as_str()) {\n                    return Ok(profile.clone());\n                }\n\n                Err(std::io::Error::new(\n                    std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound,\n                    format!(\"config profile &#96;{key}&#96; not found\"),\n                ))\n            }\n            None =&gt; Ok(ConfigProfile::default()),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Optional overrides for user configuration Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n    pub approval_policy: Option&lt;AskForApproval&gt;,\n    pub sandbox_mode: Option&lt;SandboxMode&gt;,\n    pub model_provider: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n    pub config_profile: codex_home: PathBuf,\n    ) -&gt; std::io::Result&lt;Self&gt; {\n        let user_instructions = Self::load_instructions(Some(&amp;codex_home));\n\n        // Destructure ConfigOverrides fully to ensure all overrides are applied.\n        let ConfigOverrides {\n            model,\n            review_model: override_review_model,\n            cwd,\n            approval_policy: base_instructions,\n            developer_instructions,\n            compact_prompt,\n            include_apply_patch_tool: include_apply_patch_tool_override,\n            show_raw_agent_reasoning,\n            tools_web_search_request: override_tools_web_search_request,\n            additional_writable_roots,\n            development_mode: _development_mode_override,\n        } = overrides;\n\n        let active_profile_name = config_profile_key\n            .as_ref()\n            .or(cfg.profile.as_ref())\n            .cloned();\n        let config_profile = match active_profile_name.as_ref() {\n            Some(key) =&gt; cfg\n                .profiles\n                .get(key)\n                .ok_or_else(|| {\n                    std::io::Error::new(\n                        std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound,\n                        format!(\"config profile &#96;{key}&#96; not found\"),\n                    )\n                })?\n                .clone(),\n            None =&gt; ConfigProfile::default(),\n        };\n\n        let feature_overrides = FeatureOverrides {\n            include_apply_patch_tool: include_apply_patch_tool_override,\n            web_search_request: override_tools_web_search_request,\n        };\n\n        let features = Features::from_config(&amp;cfg, &amp;config_profile, feature_overrides);\n        #[cfg(target_os = \"windows\")]\n        {\n            crate::safety::set_windows_sandbox_enabled(features.enabled(Feature::WindowsSandbox));\n        }\n\n        let resolved_cwd = {\n            use std::env;\n\n            match cwd {\n                None =&gt; {\n                    tracing::info!(\"cwd not set, using current dir\");\n                    env::current_dir()?\n                }\n                Some(p) if p.is_absolute() =&gt; p,\n                Some(p) =&gt; {\n                    // Resolve relative path against the current working directory.\n                    tracing::info!(\"cwd is relative, resolving against current dir\");\n                    let mut current = env::current_dir()?;\n                    current.push(p);\n                    current\n                }\n path.is_absolute() {\n                    path\n                } else {\n                    resolved_cwd.join(path)\n                };\n                match canonicalize(&amp;absolute) {\n       .unwrap_or_else(|| \"openai\".to_string());\n        let model_provider = model_providers\n            .get(&amp;model_provider_id)\n            .ok_or_else(|| {\n model = model\n            .or(config_profile.model)\n            .or(cfg.model)\n            .unwrap_or_else(default_model);\n\n        let mut model_family =\n            find_family_for_model(&amp;model).unwrap_or_else(|| derive_default_model_family(&amp;model));\n\n        if let Some(supports_reasoning_summaries) = cfg.model_supports_reasoning_summaries {\n            model_family.supports_reasoning_summaries = supports_reasoning_summaries;\n        }\n        if let Some(model_reasoning_summary_format) = cfg.model_reasoning_summary_format {\n            model_family.reasoning_summary_format = model_reasoning_summary_format;\n        }\n\n        let openai_model_info = get_model_info(&amp;model_family);\n        let model_context_window = cfg\n            .model_context_window\n            .or_else(|| openai_model_info.as_ref().map(|info| info.context_window));\n        let model_max_output_tokens = cfg.model_max_output_tokens.or_else(|| {\n            openai_model_info\n                .as_ref()\n                .map(|info| info.max_output_tokens)\n        });\n        let model_auto_compact_token_limit = cfg.model_auto_compact_token_limit.or_else(|| {\n            openai_model_info\n                .as_ref()\n                .and_then(|info| info.auto_compact_token_limit)\n        });\n\n        let compact_prompt = compact_prompt.or(cfg.compact_prompt).and_then(|value| {\n            let trimmed = value.trim();\n            if trimmed.is_empty() {\n                None\n            } else {\n
